extras.agent_focus: Marketplaces and networks where storage or bandwidth is contributed by third parties for free or near-free. Two directions probed: (1) BUY side - can you consume contributed bandwidth/storage cheaply; (2) SUPPLY side - the arbitrage question, whether contributing a disk earns storage credit at better than the retail rate. Also research testbeds that hand out whole physical nodes with multi-TB local disk (CloudLab, Chameleon, FABRIC, Emulab) and community mesh networks (Guifi, Freifunk, NYC Mesh). Decided per candidate by computing 20 TiB stored + 1 TiB/day egress against that path's actual tariff.

binding_note: one stream is shaped, and aggregate throughput is the shaped rate times the number of streams
